title: Junior QA Engineer
description: Entry-level QA engineer focused on structured test case authoring, comprehensive defect reporting, manual functional & smoke testing, DOM inspection with DevTools, writing baseline UI tests in Playwright/Cypress, Postman API testing, and basic JMeter/accessibility checks.

skills.rationale: Writing high-quality reproducible test cases and logging detailed bug reports with environment details and logs is fundamental for daily tasks.
Applying black-box test design techniques and understanding STLC phases in Agile sprints.
Inspecting HTML DOM trees, crafting resilient XPath/CSS selectors, and analyzing Network tab HTTP requests.
Writing straightforward automated UI tests in Cypress or Playwright using resilient locator strategies (getByRole/getByTestId).
Validating RESTful endpoints and writing JavaScript test assertions in Postman collections.
Tracking test cases and runs in TestRail/Zephyr and managing defect lifecycles in Jira.
Executing basic JMeter load tests and running automated accessibility audits using axe-core and WAVE.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in manual testing fundamentals, test case authoring, or basic bug reporting.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Can execute test cases and report bugs, but needs guidance on test design techniques, locator resilience, and Postman assertions.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Solid manual testing foundation, good grasp of DevTools and Postman, and writes reliable beginner automation scripts.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all junior expectations: delivers thorough test cases, logs precise bug reports, automates core UI/API flows, and tracks STLC metrics.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds junior expectations with early mid-level proficiency in Page Object Model, k6 load testing, and CI/CD test job integration.
